name: pr-walkthrough
description: Two pull request skills: a deep evidence-backed code walkthrough, and a fast product and business brief. Both render a portable HTML artifact.

interface.shortDescription: Review PRs as code, or brief them as product impact.
interface.longDescription: Two skills over a frozen GitHub pull request. pr-walkthrough reviews it with native agent passes, verifies findings against source, and renders a keyboard-navigable HTML walkthrough. pr-brief answers the product and business questions in one pass and renders a short evidence-grounded brief.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $pr-walkthrough to review this pull request and build the HTML walkthrough. Keep the run read-only unless I explicitly ask to publish.
